name: Maneki 88 Gold

features.name: Golden symbols
features.description: Gold versions of symbols pay more.

features.name: High-only free spins
features.description: Only premium symbols, scatters and wilds land in the bonus.

review:
Maneki 88 Gold is a 243-ways lucky-cat slot where symbols can turn golden and pay more than their standard versions. Special coin wilds lead towards a jackpot.

The free spins round awards 10 spins with only high-paying symbols, scatters and wilds, and three or more scatters during the round add 10 more, up to a cap of 300 free spins. The bonus can be bought with a set number of golden symbols where permitted. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 2,500x maximum and a 96.75% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 109 spins on average. It's the predecessor of Maneki 88 Fortunes.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 109 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
